shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Vakadzi vazhinji vakazvitakura havakwanisi kupedza zuva vasina kurara. [cite: 417] Edzai kuronga nguva yekuzorora pakati pezuva. [cite: 418]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Muri kutarisira kuenda kunoonekwa naChiremba kechitatu. [cite: 424] Muchaitwa sonogram kana level II sonogram, inotarisa makuriro emwana zvakadzama. [cite: 425] Muchaitwawo ongororo inonzi Maternal Serum Alpha-Fetoprotein Screening (MSAFP). [cite: 426]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Itsvo dzinenge dzava kugadzira weti uye vhudzi rinenge rava kumera mumusoro wemwana. [cite: 440] Nzvimbo dzepfungwa dzinoita nezvekunzwa nekuona dzinenge dzarongeka. [cite: 441] Kana mwana ari musikana, anenge atova nemazai anosvika mamirioni matanhatu. [cite: 441]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Kurwadza kweround ligament kunowanikwa pasecond trimester, kunonzwikwa sedumbu kana patsandanyama. [cite: 434] Vamwe vakadzi vanoita chirungurira nekuti mahormones anokanganisa zvivharo zvemudumbu. [cite: 430] Constipation inogona kuitikawo. [cite: 432]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Dzungu panguva yekuzvitakura rinokonzerwa ne'hypotension' (low blood pressure). [cite: 443] Rinopedzwa nekurara nedivi uye kusimuka zvishoma nezvishoma. [cite: 444, 445]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Nekuti wava nepamuviri, zvakanaka kungwarira pakushandisa mishonga yechivanhu. [cite: 447] Tinokurudzira kuti usatore mishonga iyi usati wataurirana nachiremba wako. [cite: 448]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Mwana wako anenge akaputirwa nezvinhu zvichena zvinonzi 'vernix caseosa,' zvinobatsira kuchengetedza ganda rake. [cite: 460] Zvinobatsirawo kufamba kwemwana munzira yaanobuda nayo. [cite: 461] Mwana anenge ava kutanga kugadzira tsvina yake yekutanga (meconium). [cite: 462]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Kumusoro kwemimba yako kwava nechepaguvhudende. [cite: 455] Panguva iyi, unogona kunge wawedzera kurema ne 4.5kg. [cite: 455] Tarisira kuwedzera ne 0.23 to 0.45kg pavhiki. [cite: 456] Chiveve, kuzvimba maoko nemakumbo, nekuoma kwemaziso zvinowanzoitika. [cite: 453]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Rangarira kuti zvakakosha kuwana iron yakakwana, iyo inobatsira kugadzira 'haemoglobin' uye kudzivirira 'anemia.' [cite: 466] Unofanira kutora 27-30mg pazuva. [cite: 466] Iron inowanikwa munyama tsvuku, nyama yenguruve, bhinzi, uye spinach. [cite: 467, 468, 469, 470]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Iyi inguva yekutanga kufunga nezvekuzvarwa kwemwana wako. [cite: 476] Zama kunyora pfungwa dzako neurongwa hwako mubhuku kuti zvikubatsire kuzivisa zvaunoda kune vachamira newe. [cite: 478]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Hurefu hwemwana hwava kutorwa kubva kumusoro kusvika pachitsitsinho (CHL). [cite: 491] Ma'eyelids' emwana anopera kugadzirwa panguva iyi, uye anenge achitamba achimedza 'amniotic fluid.' [cite: 493] Matumbu emwana anoramba achikura. [cite: 494] Kana mwana ari musikana, nhengo yake inenge yagadzirwa asi inoramba ichinatsiridzwa. [cite: 495]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Mukabata pamusoro peguvhu, mogona kunzwa chibereko chenyu. [cite: 487] Mukaona makumbo netsoka zvichizvimba, edzai kuwana nguva yekugara nekuzorora. [cite: 488] Zvakakosha kutariswa BP yenyu mazuva ose nekuda kwe'pre-eclampsia.' [cite: 485] Mukanzwa kutemwa nemusoro kana kuzvimba muviri, endai kuchipatara nekukasika. [cite: 485]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: UTI (chirwere chenzira yeweti) chinowanda muvanhu vakazvitakura. [cite: 497] Munogona kuchidzivirira nekunwa magirazi 6-8 emvura mazuva ose uye kuzvipukuta kubva kumberi kuenda kumashure. [cite: 499]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Pamunenge muchiwedzera kusimba, munogona kuona muchizvimba tsinga dzeropa ('varicose veins'), zvinowanzoitika mumakumbo nepanhengo yechidzimai. [cite: 503]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Mwana wenyu akuratidzika sekamucheche kunyangwe achiri mudiki. [cite: 515] Ganda rake rinenge richakaregedzera nekuti haasati asimba zvakanyanya. [cite: 516] Maziso anenge agadzirwa, asi 'iris' inenge isati yavepo. [cite: 516, 517] Rwatata rwurkuramba rwuchikura. [cite: 517]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Munogona kunzwa chibereko chenyu 2cm pamusoro peguvhu renyu. [cite: 513] Pamuviri panokonzera kuti bvudzi rikore nekupenya uye nzara dzikasike kukura. [cite: 510] Ganda repadumbu rinogona kuoma nekurwadza. [cite: 511]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Madzimai mazhinji vanotanga kufunganya kuti vanogona kukasira kutanga kugomera. [cite: 519] Ongororo inonzi 'Fetal fibronectin (fFN)' inogona kuitwa. [cite: 520] Kana 'fibronectin' ikaonekwa mumvura dzemunzira yemwana pama vhiki ari pakati pe 22 ne 38, zvinogona kuratidza njodzi yekukasira kugomera. [cite: 522]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Tsvagai vanopa dzidziso dzezvekuzvibatsira. [cite: 525] Edzai kupedza zvidzidzo izvi vhiki re 37 risati rapera. [cite: 526]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Mwana arikuwedzera kusimba. [cite: 538] Bvudzi riri paganda ('lanugo') richatanga kusvibira, zvoita kuti rioneke pa'ultrasound scan.' [cite: 538] Mwana wenyu akutaridzika sekamucheche. [cite: 538]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Chibereko chenyu chakura kusvika 3.8cm kubva paguvhu, uye mawedzera kurema ne 5.4kg - 6.8kg. [cite: 533] Chibereko chakagara pamusoro pedundira, zvinogona kukonzera kuti weti ibude yega. [cite: 534] Mvura yekuputika shupa haina hwema; kana mukafungidzira kuti haisi weti, fonerai vanoona nezveutano. [cite: 535, 536]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Kunwa mvura yakawanda kwakakosha. [cite: 540] Kana muchinwa mvura yakakwana, weti yenyu inenge yakacheneruka. [cite: 542] Izvi zvinobatsira kudzivirira kutemwa nemusoro, kurwadza kwechibereko, nehosha yenzira yeweti. [cite: 543, 544]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Kana muchishanda, munofanira kunge makupedzisa kugadzirisa mapepa ezororo. [cite: 546] Munofanira kuudzwa nezvekodzero dzenyu panguva yekuzvitakura. [cite: 547] Zvakakosha kukurukura nemurume wenyu kuti ndiani achachengeta mwana kana madzokera kubasa. [cite: 549]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Pfungwa dzemwana dziri kukura chaizvo. [cite: 560] Ma'taste buds' ave kugadzirwawo, uye mapapu arikuumba zvakakomba. [cite: 560] Mushonga unonzi 'surfactant' unobatsira mapapu kupinza mweya uri kugadzirwawo. [cite: 561]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Munogona kunzwa chibereko chenyu 5cm pamusoro peguvhu. [cite: 555] Ganda repadumbu nepamazamu rinotatamuka, zvichikonzera kutswinya. [cite: 555] Shandisai mafuta ekuzora. [cite: 556] Maziso enyu anogonawo kuoma kana kurwadza. [cite: 557]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Kana muchiita dambudziko rechirungurira, munofanira kudya kashoma kashoma. [cite: 563] Kuregedza kudyira dyira kana kudya mave kuda kurara kunobatsirawo. [cite: 563]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Pakati pevhiki 24 ne 28, vanoona nezveutano vanoongorora shuga yenyu muropa. [cite: 565] Ongororo iyi inoona kana mune chirwere cheshuga chepamuviri, icho chinokonzerwa nekutadza kushanda kwe'insulin.' [cite: 566]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Mwana ari kusimba, izvo zvinoita kuti ganda rake risanuke. [cite: 578] Kana mwana aine bvudzi, ruvara rwacho runenge rwava kuoneka. [cite: 579] Kuona kuti mwana mukomana here kana musikana kunogona kuitwa ne'ultrasound' kana 'NIPT' (noninvasive prenatal testing). [cite: 580, 581]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Chibereko chenyu chakura kunge bhora renhabvu, uye pamusoro pacho pasvika pakati peguvhu nebhonzo rinobatanidza mbabvu. [cite: 576] Munogona kunzwa chiveve mumaoko, chinonzi 'carpal tunnel syndrome,' chichikonzerwa nekuzvimba nekuwanda kwemvura mumuviri. [cite: 574]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Munofanira kutanga kufunga nezvezita rekupa mwana. [cite: 585] Zvibvunzei kuti mungade mazita ake atange nemavara api, uye kana paine mazita emadunhurirwa angabve pazita iri. [cite: 588, 589]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Munogona kunzwa kuda kuchengeta mifananidzo ye'ultrasound,' asi zvinogona kuva nenjodzi kuutano. [cite: 592] Munofanira kupihwa mvumo nachiremba kuti mutorwe 'ultrasound scan.' [cite: 592]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Tsinga dzemagetsi dzemunzeve dzave kugadzirwa, dzichibatsira kuti mwana atange kunzwa. [cite: 604] Mwana achiri kumedza 'amniotic fluid,' izvo zvinobatsira kugadzira mapapu. [cite: 604] Kana mwana ari mukomana, mabhora ake akutanga kudzika kwaanogara. [cite: 604]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Chibereko chenyu chave kusvika 6.3cm kubva paguvhu. [cite: 599] Panguva yasara, pamuviri penyu panenge pachikura 1.25cm pavhiki. [cite: 599] Munogona kunge mawedzera kurema ne 7.25-10kg. [cite: 600] Kana kutswinya kwakanyanya, munofanira kuona chiremba nekuti zvinogona kunge zviri 'cholestasis of pregnancy.' [cite: 597]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Munokurudzirwa kudya derere, rine macalories mashoma nema vitamins mazhinji. [cite: 606] Rinobatsira kuti musaite tsvina yakaomarara. [cite: 607] Beans dzine maproteins akawanda uye 'folic acid,' 'iron,' nezvimwe zvakakosha. [cite: 608]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Pamuchanoonekwa, gadzirirai kuongororwa ropa, masoja emuviri ('Rh factor'), ne 'glucose tolerance test' kutarisa chirwere cheshuga. [cite: 611, 612, 613, 614]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Mwana akugona kuvhara nekuvhura maziso ake. [cite: 631] Ave nenguva yekurara nekumuka, iyo ingasiyana neyenyu. [cite: 631] Munogona kunzwa munhikwi wemwana, izvo zvinoitika uye zvisingafanire kutyiwa. [cite: 632]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Panguva ino, makunzwa mwana achitamba zvikuru. [cite: 627] Pamavhiki anotevera, munogona kuzonzi muverenge kuti arikutamba kangani. [cite: 627] Pamusoro pekurwadziwa musana nemakumbo, vamwe vakadzi vanoita 'haemorrhoids.' [cite: 624]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Kana muine mota, munokurudzirwa kutenga chigaro chemwana chemumota. [cite: 634] Mucherechedze kuti chinoenderana nemota yenyu uye chakanatsogadzikwa. [cite: 635]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Kana manga musati matanga zvidzidzo zvekubatsirwa nekurera mucheche, munokurudzirwa kuti mutange. [cite: 637] Munofanira kunge mapedza zvidzidzo izvi vhiki re 37 risati rapera. [cite: 637]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Pfungwa dzemwana dzave kuita mihomba mihomba. [cite: 652] Kukura kwepfungwa kunowedzera. [cite: 653] Ma 'eyebrows' nema 'eyelashes' zvave kuoneka, uye bvudzi riri kuramba richikura. [cite: 653] Mwana ari kuramba achisimbasimba sezvo ari kuita mafuta pasi peganda. [cite: 653]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Panoperera chibereko pave kusvika 8.9cm kana kupfuura pamusoro peguvhu. [cite: 647] Munogona kunge mawedzera kusimba ne 7.7-10.8kg. [cite: 647] Madzimai mazhinji anotanga kurwadziwa makumbo, kuita tsvina yakaomarara, kushaya hope, nema 'haemorrhoids.' [cite: 648] Mwana anogona kurarama kana akazvarwa kubva pavhiki rino nerubatsiro rwe ICU. [cite: 643] Kubuda ropa pashure pemavhiki 28 kunogona kukonzerwa ne 'placenta previa,' iyo inoisa njodzi kuna amai nemwana. [cite: 643]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Zvakanaka kutanga kugadzirira rwendo rwekuenda kunobatsirwa kuchipatara. [cite: 655] Ngwarirai kuti mugare nenhamba dzerunhare dzemurume wenyu, uye gadziriraiwo nzira dzekuenda kuchipatara. [cite: 656, 657]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Pamuchaenda kunoongororwa, gadzirirai kupihwa 'Rhogam' kana muine 'Rh factor.' [cite: 661] Pachavewo nehurukuro pamusoro pekucherechedza kutamba kwemwana, zvidzidzo zvekubatsirwa, uye kusarudza pakati pekuyamwisa kana kushandisa bhodhoro. [cite: 662, 663]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Mwana wako ava kukura nekukasika. [cite: 677] Musoro wake uri kuramba uchikura nekuda kwekukura kwepfungwa. [cite: 677, 678] Mhasuro nemapapu zviri kuramba zvichikura. [cite: 678]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Kurema kwako kunenge kwawedzera ne 8.6-11.3kg. [cite: 672] Kumusoro kwechibereko chako kunenge kuri 8.9-10cm kubva paguvhu. [cite: 672] Constipation inogona kukonzera marwadzo mudumbu. [cite: 673] 'Colostrum,' mukaka wekutanga, unogona kutanga kubuda mumazamu. [cite: 669]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: 'Dawa community healthcare worker' anobatsira mai kuti vazvare zvakanaka. [cite: 683] Vanokushanyira kakawanda uye vanouya kuzokuona pachavo. [cite: 685, 687]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Kuti udzivirire 'constipation,' idya zvikafu zvine 'fibre,' imwa mvura yakawanda, uye ita ma'exercises.' [cite: 690, 691, 692] Dzikisa kana kumira kutora 'iron supplement.' [cite: 694]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Maziso emwana anenge akura, uye anenge ava kuziva musiyano wechiedza nerima. [cite: 709] Vana vepavhiki 30 vanogona kutevera chiedza nemaziso avo. [cite: 710] Vachangozvarwa vanogona kungotarisa zvinhu zviri mainches mashoma kubva kumeso kwavo. [cite: 711]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Unogona kutanga kunzwa kukurumidza kuneta. [cite: 701] Kana uri kutadza kurara, unogona kunoona chiremba wako. [cite: 702] Muviri wako unenge uchigadzira mahormones anoita kuti majoints apere simba, izvo zvinogona kuita kuti tsoka dzikure. [cite: 703, 704]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Iyi inguva yekufunga nezvenzira dzekupodza marwadzo dzaungawana panguva yekuzvara. [cite: 714] Ita tsvakurudzo yako wega kuti uite sarudzo ine uchenjeri. [cite: 715] Nzira dziripo dzinosanganisira 'natural childbirth,' 'local anesthesia' (epidural), 'narcotics,' uye 'patterned breathing.' [cite: 718, 719, 20, 722]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Vakadzi vakawanda vanochema nekurwadziwa nemusana panguva iyi. [cite: 714] Funga nezvenzira dzekupodza marwadzo paunozvara. [cite: 714]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Mwana ari kuramba achiwedzera uremu nekukura. [cite: 735] Mafuta ari pasi peganda rake arikuwedzera, izvo zvinomupa chitarisiko chemwana achangoberekwa. [cite: 736] Pakuzvarwa, vana vazhinji vanenge vave kurema 3-3.4kg. [cite: 736]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Munogona kuona mukaka wekutanga ('colostrum') uchibuda mumazamu. [cite: 729] Munogona kushandisa 'nurse pads' kuti usatotesa hembe. [cite: 730] 'Braxton Hicks contractions' (kumonya kwechibereko) dzinoitika kwechinguva chipfupi, uye dzinoita kuti chibereko chigadzirire kuzvara. [cite: 731, 732] Zvimwe zviratidzo zvekutanga kwenhumbu zvinogona kudzoka. [cite: 727]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: 'Haemorrhoids' dzinowanzoitika pachikamu chechitatu chekuzvitakura. [cite: 740] Munogona kuzvirapa nekushandisa 'baking soda,' kugeza mumvura inodziya, kana kushandisa 'lemon juice.' [cite: 742, 743, 745] Zvinonyanyobatsira kudzivirira 'constipation.' [cite: 748]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Inguva yakanaka yekuongorora kana muchazoda kuyamwisa kana kushandisa bhodhoro. [cite: 750] Munogonawo kukurukura nachiremba nezvekuchengeta 'cord blood' yemwana. [cite: 750]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Zvigunwe zvemumaoko nemutsoka zvaumbwa. [cite: 760] Mapapu achiri kukura. [cite: 760] Mabhonzo emuviri avepo, kunyange asati anyatsosimba. [cite: 760]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Chibereko chenyu chinenge chakura 12cm kudarika pamusoro peguvhu. [cite: 756] Kukura uku kunogona kukonzera chirungurira nekukufemerai. [cite: 756] Muviri uri kuwedzera huremu hunosvika 0.5kg vhiki rega rega. [cite: 757]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Zvimwe zvingabatsire kuderedza 'Braxton Hicks contractions' zvinosanganisira kushandura chimiro, kugeza nemvura inodziya, uye kunwa mvura kana mukaka. [cite: 763, 764, 765, 766, 767]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Kana pasina zvikonzero, manga muchiona chiremba mwedzi wega wega, asi izvi zvinogona kushanduka kuita mavhiki maviri ega ega. [cite: 770, 771] Mukufamba kwenguva, munogona kutanga kuenda vhiki rega rega. [cite: 772]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Mabhonzo emuviri ari kuita achisimba. [cite: 787]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Muviri wenyu unenge wawedzera ne 10-12kg. [cite: 782] Kana shupa ikaputika, munoona tumvura tunoerera nemumakumbo. [cite: 783, 784] Kana mvura iyi ichinhuwa kana kuva neruvara, zvinogona kuratidza 'infection,' saka kurumidzai kuzivisa chiremba. [cite: 785]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Hapana chingakutadzisei kuenda pabonde kana muine mimba, kunze kwekunge paine chikonzero chamunenge maudzwa nachiremba. [cite: 789]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Munogona kukurukura nachiremba nezve 'episiotomy' (kuchekwa panzira inobuda nemwana). [cite: 775] Mazuva ano, 'episiotomy' haichanyanyo kushandiswa. [cite: 791] Zvingabatsire kuti musaitwe 'episiotomy' zvinosanganisira kudya kwakakwana, 'Kigels,' uye kupuruzira imba yechibereko. [cite: 792, 793, 794, 797]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Mafuta emuviri wemwana arikuwedzera, izvo zvinozobatsira kuchengetedza kudziya kwemuviri wake achinge azvarwa. [cite: 805] Pfungwa dzake dzichiri kuumbwa. [cite: 806] Mwana akazvarwa panguva ino (gavamwedzi) anokwanisa kurarama. [cite: 806]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Chibereko chenyu chinenge chakura 14cm kudarika pamusoro peguvhu. [cite: 802] Munogona kuona guvhu rave kunyanya kubudikira; munogona kushandisa kabhandeji kana tepi kurivhara. [cite: 803]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Danho rekutanga regomero rinotanga kusvika muromo wechibereko wavhurika kusvika pa 10cm. [cite: 808] Danho rechipiri nderekuzvarwa kwemwana, uye danho rechitatu nderekubuditsa chevakuru. [cite: 811]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Panguva ino, chiremba wenyu anokurukura nemi nezve 'Group B strep infection,' mazuva ekuonekwa, uye mishonga yamungade pakugomera. [cite: 813, 814, 815, 817]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Kukura kwake kwave kutotsaruka. [cite: 830] Itsvo dzanyatsokura, uye chiropa chave kutanga kushanda. [cite: 830] Kutamba kwake hakufaniri kushanduka, kunyange nzvimbo yave shoma. [cite: 831]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Muviri hauchanyanyo kuwedzera huremu; unenge wawedzera ne 10.9-13.2kg. [cite: 825] Kushaya hope kunogona kutanga. [cite: 826] Kufemereka pamusoro kunodzikira kana mwana adzika mutsandanyama ('pelvis'), asi izvi zvinowedzera kuenda kuchimbuzi. [cite: 826, 827]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Zvakanaka kugadzirira chiremba wevana ('paediatrician') achazomuona. [cite: 833] Munogona kufanobvunza nezve maimyunisesheni uye zvekuita kana paine dambudziko nemwana. [cite: 835]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Chiremba wenyu anogona kutanga kukuonai vhiki rega rega. [cite: 837] Vachiongorora kutamba kwemwana, uye munogona kuzviitawo mega, muchiverenga nguva yaanotora kutamba kagumi. [cite: 837, 838] Munofanira kunzwa kutamba kwake kagumi mumaawa maviri. [cite: 840]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Vhudzi ('lanugo') riri paganda remwana ravekupera. [cite: 850] Mwana anofanira kunge aine musoro wakatarisa kuzasi ('cephalic position'). [cite: 851] Kana asati, chiremba anogona kushandisa nzira dzekuti abude zvakanaka. [cite: 852]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Pamwe marukutika nekukura kwedumbu. [cite: 847] Munogona kunzwa kuti kumonya ('Braxton Hicks contraction') kuri kuwedzera. [cite: 848] Mwana ari kudzika mutsandanyama, zvoita kuti mufeme zvakanaka. [cite: 845]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Shandisai 'nursing bra' kana mazamu achirwadza makarara. [cite: 854]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Gadzirirai zvamungade kuzoshandisa kuchipatara. [cite: 844] Zvingadiwe naAmai zvinosanganisira 'medical insurance card,' 'breast pads,' uye 'sanitary pads.' [cite: 856, 857, 858, 860] Zvingadiwe neMwana zvinosanganisira chigaro chemota, zvipfeko, nemanapukeni. [cite: 861, 862, 864, 865]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Nyangwe mwana akura kusvika pakukwanisa kuzvarwa, zvakanaka kuti arambe ari munhumbu kusvika nguva yanyatsokwana. [cite: 876]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Muviri hauchanyanyo kuwedzera huremu, unenge wawedzera ne 11.3-15.9kg. [cite: 872] Mvura yemunhumbu ('amniotic fluid') yave kudzikira. [cite: 872] Munogona kuita 'discharge' yechidzihwa, chinovhara pamuromo wechibereko; izvi zvinoratidza kuti muromo wechibereko wave kuvhurika. [cite: 873, 874]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Pedzisai kugadzirira kuuya kwemwana. [cite: 877] Zvakanaka kugadzirira kana paine achazokubatsirai nebasa mumba uye kubika. [cite: 879]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Pedzisai zvidzidzo zvekuzvara uye gadzirirai imba yamuchazova nemwana. [cite: 878]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Muviri wemwana wanyatsokura, kwangosara uropi nemapapu, ayo anoramba achikura kunyange azvarwa. [cite: 885]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Tsoka dzenyu dzinogona kuzvimba. [cite: 883] Asi kana maoko, chiso, nemakumbo zvikazvimba zvisinganzwisisike, kurumidzai kuudza chiremba, nekuti zvingave 'preeclampsia.' [cite: 883]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Kana mwana asina kugara zvakanaka ('breech position'), chiremba anogona kuti muitwe imwe 'scan.' [cite: 887] Munogona kuitwa 'non-stress test' kuti muongorore utano hwemwana. [cite: 888, 889]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Chiremba wenyu anogona kukurukura nemi nezvemunhu wekufonera kana matanga kugomera, uye zvekuita kana mwana akurumidza kubuda. [cite: 891, 892]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Mafuta epasi peganda remwana ari kuramba achikura, izvo zvakakosha kuti akwanise kuchengetedza tembiricha yakanaka. [cite: 904] Mwana anenge atanga kugadzira 'skin cells' matsva. [cite: 905]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Unogona kusaona shanduko yakawanda. [cite: 898] Kana wosvika pakupera kwepamuviri, muromo wechibereko unoita 'effacement,' kureva kuti unopfava, wopfupika, nekuonda, uchigadzirira kuzvarwa kwemwana. [cite: 899, 900, 901] Zviratidzo zvelabour zvinosanganisira 'regular contractions,' 'pelvic pressure,' uye marwadzo emusana. [cite: 896]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Ramba uchiterera kutamba-tamba kwemwana. [cite: 907] Unogona kumira kumbovhura zvipo zvemwana, nekuti zvinogona zvisingakwane kana kuva zverudzi rusiri iro. [cite: 908]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Panguva iyi, unofanira kuronga kuti zvikuitire nyore. [cite: 911] Iva nenguva yako, neyemurume wako, neyemhuri yako. [cite: 912]

kukura_kwemwana.pfupiso: Mabhonzo emwana aomarara, kunze kweedehenya. [cite: 945] Mabhonzo edehenya anofanira kuramba akapfava kuti agomanikidzika munzira yemwana. [cite: 945] Nekuda kweizvi, musoro wake unogona kuita kunge 'cone' pamazuva ekutanga. [cite: 946] Mwana achiri nenhova mbiri ('fontanelles') dzinobatsira pakuzvara. [cite: 947]

shanduko_kuna_amai.kushanduka_kwemuviri: Paunogomera, musoro wemwana unotanga kubuda. [cite: 939] 'Crowning' ndiko kubuda kwemusoro wemwana usingachadzokere shure. [cite: 939] Paunoita 'crowning,' unonzwa kakutsva; paunongonzwa izvi, mira kugomera kuti usazviisa panjodzi yekuita ronda. [cite: 940, 941] 'Postpartum haemorrhage' (kubuda ropa rakawanda) ndechimwe chezvinogona kuitika, uye chinokonzerwa nekudambuka kwetsinga dzeropa kana matambudziko ne 'placenta.' [cite: 917, 920, 923]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvingabatsire: Uchangobva kuzvara, mwana wako anoongororwa ne 'APGAR test,' iyo inoratidza chimiro chake. [cite: 950, 952] Zvibodzwa zvacho zvinotorwa pamineti rekutanga nerechishanu. [cite: 952] Mazano ekurwisa kuda kugomera anosanganisira kuzorora wakazembera nemusana uye kuisa simba pakufema. [cite: 954, 955, 957]
shanduko_kuna_amai.zvekuronga_pavhiki: Paprenatal visit yako yekupedzisira, gadzirira matests anoti 'Non-stress test' ne 'Amniotic fluid index.' [cite: 960, 961, 962] Chiremba achataura newe pamusoro pekupfuudza mazuva epamuviri, 'induction,' uye 'caesarean birth.' [cite: 964, 965, 966, 967]
